Move the application classes into the yanny package, apply the coding standard, and update the setup instructions to reflect the new source paths. Preserve the existing task-management behavior.

commitResults.messageBody:
The main method currently handles application startup, input reading, command dispatch, task mutation, parsing, and output in one long method. This makes the control flow difficult to read and increases the cost of future command changes.

Extract command-specific processing into focused private methods while keeping the existing task storage, parsing behavior, and user-visible output unchanged. This reduces the size and responsibility of main and makes each command path easier to understand and maintain.
